about: Manifest for tools/rebuild_drafts.py: the drafted guide chapters, rebuilt from the data pack. Chapter files are generated; change this file, tools/hardcore_rules.json or the tools, not the chapter text. "hardcore" says which guides are HARDCORE routes (elite and sourced dangerous quests left out); the others are normal routes (group quests tagged optional). A guide with a "planned" note was installed from tools/route_planner.py --install and is not drafted: its chapter entries stay for the planner's --chain and --exclude hints.
